status: completed numerical iteration; not a journal-level success claim
question: Use causal contact information to update impedance rapidly during continuous soft-tissue scanning, improving force and motion together under execution limits.
candidate1: Hertz estimation -> local quadratic finite-horizon value feedback -> directional neighboring Riccati update and correction -> actual four-gain-rate execution
candidate1_representation: Global quadratic collocation failed; explicit local HJB/iLQR representation change, approximate neighboring sensitivity, no B0 fixed-node certificate
candidate2: Same causal estimation/preview and execution states -> task-gradient offline training -> direct four-gain-rate network

core_experiments.purpose: Force and motion performance when stiffness, friction or surface motion changes; report physical errors separately from aggregate cost.
Separately remove spatial material preview and moment observation, without supplying true future fields.
Neighboring value-feedback update versus the same value solver without neighboring prediction; count sensitivity preparation and actual publication delay.
Independently train with/without estimated preview; test unseen scenes and train seeds; record offline work and online inference.
Record gain/rate/tank, force, motion, torque and contact constraint margins, including failures. Sampled checks do not certify continuous safety.

plant: 2-DOF planar torque-interface synthetic instance of B0, Hertz two-region pressure integration, surface motion, four gain states and tank. No direct force servo is added.
task_cost: B0 tracking + velocity + force + positive gain-preference + positive rate penalty + terminal tracking/force cost; see physics.py for fixed numerical scales.

paper_examples.learn: Separate precision/compliance and constraint experiments; do not transplant its planar obstacle task.
Randomized training, distinct terrain tests, unseen parameters and training convergence; its UR5 force-tracking task is different.
Task cost and computation comparison; declare training-only privileged information and deployment observations.
Model fidelity and force/position cost tradeoff; zero desired-force interface is not assumed suitable for nonzero force scanning.

workflow: research question and candidate mechanisms -> separate candidate code/experiments -> select a suitable external method -> source-equation reconstruction and fair task adaptation

external_baseline.task_adaptation: nonzero-force planar scanning, common actuator limits
external_baseline.source_solver_replacement: analytic-gradient L-BFGS on transformed source problem
